title: Docs or blog article
description: An MDX article: breadcrumb trail, title and summary, Markdown rendered through the /mdx component map, and an on-page heading nav

quality.mdx: mdxComponents, or createMdxComponents({...}) to replace an element or register a tag, from @once-ui-system/core/mdx — never a hand-written element map
quality.trail: Breadcrumbs above the title; the last item has no href and is the current page
quality.width: Article column maxWidth="m"; the heading nav beside it hides at m
quality.anchors: The map gives headings ids and copy-link anchors that HeadingNav reads; they toast on copy, so render inside ToastProvider
quality.code: Fenced code renders through CodeBlock, so the app installs prismjs
